traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Aster (p. 310), which then held Symphyotrichum: leaves alternate, entire or toothed.

traits.pappus.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Aster (p. 310), which then held Symphyotrichum: pappus of nearly equal capillary persistent bristles.

traits.capitulum_kind.note: Flora of North America vols. 19-21, genus Symphyotrichum (read on eFloras 2026-11-02): heads usually radiate, rarely disciform.
